text:
vic: noticed a spike in provisioning errors in eu-west-2 during the firewall rollout. GPU nodes failing keystore decrypts and warmpool join is stalled. anyone touching egress rules?
anika: I saw that too. nodes show "KMS.Decrypt AccessDenied" then TLS timeouts to the privatelink proxy.
phil: quick lookup of the TF apply shows someone tightened the egress to privatelink proxies but replaced the legacy 10.2.0.0/16 superset with a smaller CIDR list. looks like AZ C proxies were excluded.
ops-oncall: opening P1 INC-6210. immediate mitigation: add temporary SG egress to restore 10.2.0.0/16:443 from gpu subnets. can i get emergency sign-off?
vic: emergency OK, do it. we cannot keep the fleet degraded.
anika: applying manual rule now:
```bash
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-egress --group-id sg-gpu-provisioning --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 10.2.0.0/16 --region eu-west-2
```
ops-oncall: rule applied, watching warmpool.
deploy-bot: deploy-rollout: warmpool health check failing -> suppressed due to incident.
telemetry-bot: detected missing keystore.decrypt audit events between 2026-03-23T16:05:00 and 2026-03-23T16:20:00 for eu-west-2. opened SIEM ticket SIEM-1357 for re-ingest.
phil: nodes start rejoining, +8 healthy in 4m, backlog draining. good. :relieved:
ops-oncall: noting downstream cost impact: autoscaler created fallback nodes in us-east; cross-region pulls for models ~1.1TB estimated, egress delta ~+$1.6k. tagging for RCA.
anika: I pushed a firewall repo PR to reintroduce the superset rule and add an explicit per-AZ allow. PR: https://git.internal/rw/firewall/pull/1011
vic: please add an automated preflight check to the TF pipeline that attempts a KMS handshake via the privatelink from a GPU canary in each AZ. if it fails, the pipeline should block.
phil: filing INFRA-539 for TF preflight and INFRA-540 for a per-AZ canary smoke in rollout jobs.
ops-oncall: incident INC-6210 -> mitigated after manual rule. keeping open until SIEM confirms re-ingest and PR merges.
telemetry-bot: SIEM-1357 accepted re-ingest request; retention team ETA 18-24h.
anika: also adding a unit test in the firewall repo that fails if a CIDR change would drop addresses from the known-proxy list. will include that with PR 1011.
vic: follow-ups: merge PR, INFRA-539/540 work, SIEM confirmation, cost calc for retro. thanks all.
ops-oncall: will update INC-6210 and SIEM-1357 when complete.
phil: one suggestion for the runbook: explicitly call out restoring the superset and blocking pipeline until a canary passes. avoids manual hotfixes.
vic: agreed. adding to runbook changes. closing thread once SIEM backfill done. :thumbsup:
